## Summary

**Milestone 1: GraphQL + Types + Mapper**
- Added `FaqFragment` and `FaqItemFragment` types in `src/block-renderer/types.ts`
- Added `FAQ_FIELDS` and `FAQ_ITEM_FIELDS` GraphQL fragments in `src/services/contentful/queries.ts`
- Added FAQ to `PAGE_BY_SLUG` query
- Added `mapFaq` and `mapFaqItem` mapper functions in `src/services/contentful/page.ts`
- Extended `PageSection` union type to include `FaqFragment`

**Milestone 2: Component + Config**
- Created `src/cms-components/faq/faq.tsx` component with live preview support
- Ported styling and functionality from the existing `metafi-faq.tsx` component
- Registered FAQ in `src/block-renderer/configs/index.ts`
- Added test case for FAQ rendering

**Milestone 3: Contentful Content Types**
- Created `FaqItem` content type with fields: internalName, question, answer
- Created `Faq` content type with fields: internalName, title, description, items (references to FaqItem)
- Created and published 4 sample FAQ items
- Created and published 1 FAQ entry referencing all 4 items

**Verification**
- Build passes successfully
- All TypeScript types are correct
- Component is registered and ready to use

The FAQ block is ready. You can add FAQ entries to pages in Contentful, and they will render with the expandable question/answer interface. The component supports live preview and inspector mode for editing in Contentful.
